page.overview:
Who is Alicja Troyden?

Alicja Troyden was the daughter of Gerard Troyden and had four siblings: three brothers and one sister, Anna. Unfortunately, all of her siblings tragically died.

She married Edmund Thyssen and bore him two children: son Esteril and daughter Xymena.
